living_room.name: Living room
living_room.notes: Mount it high in a corner so it sees the whole room. Keep it out of direct sun through the window, which washes out the picture.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.notes: Keep it away from the hob and kettle: steam and grease fog the lens. Microwaves can disturb Wi-Fi while they run.

bedroom.name: Bedroom
bedroom.notes: Turn the flash LED off at night so it doesn't light up the room.

nursery.name: Nursery
nursery.notes: Mount it well out of reach of the cot, with the cable clipped along the wall. A strong signal keeps the live view smooth.

front_door.name: Front door
front_door.notes: Point it at the door from inside, angled slightly down. Glass reflects at night, so press the lens close to a window or avoid one.

hallway.name: Hallway
hallway.notes: Aim it along the hall towards the doors so anyone passing is face-on.

office.name: Home office
office.notes: Keep it a little away from the router's metal case and desk monitors for a cleaner signal.

pet_corner.name: Pet corner
pet_corner.notes: Place it at about head height to your pet's bed or bowl, and tuck the cable away from chewing.

garage.name: Garage
garage.notes: Garages are often at the edge of Wi-Fi range. If the signal is weak, a cheap Wi-Fi extender nearby helps a lot.

porch_window.name: Porch window
porch_window.notes: This camera isn't weatherproof: keep it indoors, looking out through the glass with the lens right against it.
